Stock market news | SEBI physically settled commodity derivatives for FPIs from June 2027

On 27 November 2026 SEBI announced that foreign portfolio investors will be permitted to trade commodity derivatives that are physically settled beginning June 2027, replacing the existing cash-settled regime. The move introduces new risk-management rules for foreign positions, aiming to deepen market participation and improve price discovery in Indian commodity markets.
